Lucas is a city in Collin County, Texas, United States. As of the 2010 census the population was 5,166, up from 2,890 at the 2000 census; in 2020, its population was 7,612.


== Geography ==
Lucas is located in south central Collin County at 33°06′05″N 96°34′41″W. It is bordered by Fairview to the north, Allen to the west, Parker to the southwest, Wylie to the south, St.
